findings.rule_quote: This period of eight years is called as moratorium period. The moratorium would be applicable for the sums insured of the first policy and subsequently completion of 8 continuous years would be applicable from date of enhancement of sums insured only on the enhanced limits. After the expiry of Moratorium Period no health insurance policy shall be contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions specified in the policy contract.

admission_date.quote: he was hospitalized at PGIMER from 05.08.2023 to 14.08.2023 for Frontal-Occupying Lesion

inception_date.quote: he had been obtaining Health Insurance Policies from opposite parties No.1 and 2 (Insurers) since 01.04.2021

policy_renewal_date.quote: the policy was lastly renewed for the period 03.04.2023 to 02.04.2024 upon payment of premium (Annexures C-1, C-2 & C-6)

findings.question_en: For how many continuous months has this policyholder been covered, and does the insurer allege fraud?
findings.action_en: Ask the insurer to withdraw the rejection and cite the moratorium; escalate to the grievance route if refused.
